name: @neuropause/infrastructure
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Production Execution Program, Sprint 2: Enterprise Infrastructure Activation, Identity & Security. An additive package that composes Waves 1-14 and Sprint 1 (@neuropause/deploy), unchanged, into an infrastructure activation + enterprise identity/security/observability layer: an infrastructure/cluster/cloud/database/DNS activation runtime, enterprise identity (reusing the security identity registry + providers), authentication (reusing security MFA/tokens/passwordless/sessions), authorization (reusing the security RBAC/ABAC engine + tenant isolation), zero trust, secrets activation, certificate lifecycle, monitoring/telemetry/alerting/logging activation (reusing operations + the deploy monitoring config), infrastructure security, and disaster-recovery activation (reusing production DR + deploy backups). In-process runtimes — infrastructure/identity/authentication/authorization/monitoring/logging/telemetry/governance/documentation/security-policies — are LIVE-VERIFIED; external clouds (AWS/Azure/GCP/DigitalOcean/Hetzner/VMware), Vault, and identity providers (Entra ID/Google Workspace/Okta) are ADAPTER-VERIFIED until configured; customer users/organizations/production usage/operational metrics are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING (never fabricated); and un-provisioned cloud resources, undeployed clusters, unconfigured DNS, un-issued certificates, un-provisioned databases, and un-provisioned load balancers are INFRASTRUCTURE-PENDING — represented, never fabricated as live. Evidence is never promoted without real running infrastructure. Every operation is audited on the one chain with a replay id.
